name: Mininet-WiFi
what_it_is: A fork of Mininet that adds WiFi Station and Access Point emulation to enable wireless SDN experiments. It extends Mininet's virtual network framework with 802.11 wireless medium simulation while retaining full compatibility with OpenFlow and OpenvSwitch.
measurement: iw — wireless interface statistics and link information
Standard Mininet host-level traffic measurement via iperf/ping
configuration: Python script-based topology definition (Mininet API extended for wireless)
MiniEdit GUI for interactive topology creation
Pre-built Lubuntu 20.04 VM image for out-of-box deployment
Docker-based deployment as alternative installation path
fault_injection: wmediumd supports configurable wireless medium conditions (signal attenuation, interference) to simulate degraded links
modes: Script mode: Python API defining stations, APs, and links programmatically
GUI mode: MiniEdit graphical topology builder
VM mode: pre-built Lubuntu 20.04 virtual machine image
Docker mode: containerized deployment with host kernel module access
constraints: Requires Ubuntu 16.04 or higher; some hostapd features are broken on Ubuntu 14.04
Docker deployment requires --privileged mode and access to host kernel wireless modules (mac80211_hwsim)
Network Manager must be stopped on certain Ubuntu distributions to avoid interference with virtual wireless interfaces
Wireless emulation relies on mac80211_hwsim kernel module — not available in all container or VM kernels
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml found in the repository (404); Docker usage is manual docker run only
No built-in packet loss or link failure injection API (must be done via wmediumd configuration or tc/netem manually)
No native traffic generation — depends on external tools (iperf, ping, etc.)
No built-in support for LTE/5G radio access network emulation
